activities.title: Listen. What makes the team feel better? Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (preguntando al equipo) y Kili (con respuestas dulces).
data.script: Oliver: Team question: what do you do when you're sad? … Oliver: Ingrid says she swims. The water washes the sadness away, she says. … Oliver: Diego watches old funny films and laughs until his stomach hurts. … Oliver: Maya looks at the stars with her telescope. The sky is big, the problems are small. … Oliver: Me? I play slow songs on my guitar until they become happy songs. … Oliver: And Kili… Kili eats exactly seven biscuits and then hugs somebody. … Oliver: A hug from a condor fixes almost everything!
